answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 60601 Country: AF Title: Is using body cool powder has any Karahat in Ramadan? Question: Please let me know I use body cool powder in Ramadan in all over my body is it having any Karahat to my fasting or not? Please reply me as soon as possible. Answer ID: 60601 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 678/643/SN=10/1436) Yes, you may apply body cool powder over your body in the state of fast. It shall not break your fast. يستفاد مما فى الفتاوى الهندية: وما يدخل من مسام البدن من الدهن لا يفطر هكذا في شرح المجمع ، و من اغتسل في ماء وجد برده في باطنه لا يفطر هكذا فى النهر الفائق (1/303، زكريا، و انظر خير الفتاوى : 4/42) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
